newsitem.title: USA: DeBakey sees Yeltsin operation early next week.
newsitem.headline: DeBakey sees Yeltsin operation early next week.

text.p: U.S. heart surgeon Michael DeBakey said on Friday that he would leave for Moscow the following day, anticipating that doctors would perform surgery on ailing Russian President Boris Yeltsin early next week.
DeBakey told Reuters that Yeltsin appeared to be ready for the bypass operation that will improve bloodflow to his heart.
"On the basis of what they have told me, it looks like we should be able to go ahead with the operation early next week. He's improved," he said.

DeBakey, 88, will be accompanied by a team of doctors from Houston's Methodist Hospital where he performs his surgeries. It was unclear what the other physicians would do, but DeBakey has said that he will only serve as a consultant.
Russian officials said on Friday that DeBakey would not be in the operating room, but he has said that he would be.

Russian cardiologist Renat Akchurin, who trained under DeBakey at Baylor College of Medicine, will perform the operation, DeBakey said. Akchurin was in Houston recently to familiarize himself with equipment and procedures that DeBakey uses in his practice.
DeBakey, who will arrive in Moscow on Sunday, said he would meet with Yeltsin's medical team on Monday for a final consultation.

DeBakey examined Yeltsin, 65, in late September and said he would need multiple bypass surgery, meaning that several of the arteries to his heart are clogged. He predicted a full recovery for Yeltsin, but recommended that he rest for at least six weeks before the operation.
He said recently that Yeltsin, who suffered earlier heart attacks, should take no more than two months to be regain all his strength after the surgery.
Yeltsin, who is currently in a sanatorium outside Moscow, has been treated for anaemia and thyroid problems, DeBakey said.
A spokeswoman for the Methodist Hospital said an Internet page had been set up for DeBakey watchers and may be updated during his trip to Russia. The address is WWW.DeBakey.Com.
